prerequisites: Basic knowledge of material properties and common manufacturing processes.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have basic knowledge in the representation of technical products.
Students can model individual parts in a CAD system and are able to assemble them into assemblies.
Students can generate data and documents for production from simple technical components.

syllabus_topics: Representation of technical products: basic rules
Representation of technical products: creation of technical freehand drawings
Representation of technical products: dimensioning strategies
Representation of technical products: tolerances and fits
Representation of technical products: form and position tolerances
CAD: basic CAD functions and commands
CAD: object orientation, parametrics and associativity
CAD: assembly of simple parts into assemblies
Rolling bearings: areas of application of different types
Rolling bearings: constructive design of bearings
Rolling bearings: support forces and modified service life calculation
